text: The medallion layers and the security design are both planned, but nothing has landed yet. This video plans exactly how claims data reaches the lakehouse every night.
One storage folder per clinic so a bad file never blocks the rest, schema evolution set to add new columns automatically, and a 1am trigger built with real buffer.
Auto Loader tracks its own schema history separately from the data, so 15 independently-run clinic systems can each drift a little without breaking the stream.
Working backward from a 7am dashboard open leaves five hours of slack past the pipeline's expected finish -- and a missing-clinic check catches a silent gap the same morning.
The ingestion path is planned. Next: opening Databricks for real and provisioning the catalog this whole design has been pointing at.
